source: ChatGPT/Codex-authored NFL probabilities using Data Dawgs public nfelo, 538 Classic and canonical schedule snapshots; no private user forecasts
tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.

data.author: ChatGPT / Codex
data.method: Data-only probabilistic judgment anchored to current nfelo, its republished market probabilities, and Classic Elo. These inputs are correlated; this is NOT an independent model or a validated edge. Large disagreements lead to moderate forecasts, generally leaning toward current nfelo rather than preseason Classic Elo. No injury, lineup or news adjustment is claimed. The on-page chat assistant is a separate service.

inputs.hash_method: SHA-256 of the three UTF-8 file contents joined with one newline, in paths_in_hash_order

forecasts.rationale: nfelo and republished market both give Seattle 63.11%; Classic gives 69.43%. I stay close to the current feed at 64%, with only a small upward adjustment for Classic rather than counting correlated signals as independent evidence.
Neutral-site game. nfelo 57.66% and neutral-site Classic 57.07% are below the republished market 63.11%. A moderate 59% reflects the disagreement without adding home advantage.
Current nfelo and market agree at 63.11%; Classic is close at 64.24%. No material data-only reason to move away from 63%.
Indianapolis ranges from market 36.89% through nfelo 43.98% to Classic 48.44%. I put more weight on current information than the near-even preseason rating and choose 42%.

nfelo and market are about 44.3% for Houston, while Classic gives 59.38%. That large disagreement warrants caution; 47% retains the current-feed underdog direction while acknowledging rating uncertainty.
Carolina is an underdog in all three inputs: nfelo 41.5%, market 38.7%, Classic 45.23%. I retain the central, moderate 42% view.
All sources favor Jacksonville: nfelo 72.31%, market 78.65%, Classic 76.98%. I choose 75%, below the more confident market/Classic pair because their agreement is not independent evidence.
nfelo and market give Detroit 74.53%, Classic 74.14%. I use 74% with no unsupported news adjustment.
Tennessee is a modest favorite: nfelo and market 55.73%, Classic 58.59%. I stay near the current-feed 56% rather than treating the ratings as extra independent votes.
nfelo and market give Cincinnati 63.11%; Classic is lower at 59.28%. A small downward adjustment to 62% captures that uncertainty.
The Chargers are favored by nfelo 74.87%, Classic 75.99%, and market 81.11%. I choose 77%, recognizing the market but not matching its full confidence.
Minnesota ranges from market 55.73% to nfelo 60.51% and Classic 62.38%. I shade nfelo downward to 59% in recognition of the less confident market.

Upstream OAK is normalized to Las Vegas. nfelo 62.44% and market 63.11% conflict with Classic 43.50%. I lean toward the current feed but reduce confidence to 58%; no claim about the cause of the disagreement.
Philadelphia is favored by nfelo 61.67%, market 66.60%, and Classic 71.50%. I select 65%, nearer current nfelo/market than the high preseason rating.
The Giants range from market 40.53% to nfelo 45.41% and Classic 54.37%. I remain near nfelo at 46%, acknowledging disagreement without flipping the favorite solely on Classic.
Kansas City has the widest directional disagreement: Classic 42.69%, nfelo 51.33%, market 59.47%. I use a cautious 52%, close to the current model and far from either confident extreme.
